name: fresh-news feedback ON
description: Paper B headline arm: feedback ON, LLM-screened news, weights-based orders, density-gated. Run this first, then fresh_news_feedback_off.json.
notes: WHY THIS EXISTS: the original 90 runs made 15.3% of their decisions past the end
of the news corpus (it stopped 2025-11-12) and 78/552 decisions saw <100 articles
in the prior 90 days. Those runs cannot support the feedback claim. This preset
reruns the headline grid on the backfilled + relevance-screened corpus.
GATE: min_articles=50 skips any cell whose THINNEST decision sees fewer than 50
screened articles in the prior 90 days. Skipped cells are marked Skipped in the
table (not silently dropped) so they can be reported in the run ledger.
The identical gate must be used for the OFF arm or the pairing is invalid.
PREREQUISITE: finish the 2025-04..2025-09 backfill, then re-run
screen_news_relevance.py. Before that, most cells will be gated out.
order_mode=weights: the model emits target fractions, the engine does the
arithmetic. Removes the 52% budget-violation/re-prompt rate. Note this makes
these runs NOT comparable to the legacy 90, which used dollar orders.
dry_run was flipped to FALSE on 2026-07-31 to arm the live headline run.
This preset now SPENDS BUDGET the moment it is started. Re-set dry_run to true
before using it for any grid/coverage rehearsal.
